data.long_description:
Stylish and well-maintained Type 4E corner unit located in a prime position within the community in The Springs (Dubai).

Property Features:

Type 4E (Corner Unit)
2 Bedrooms + Study Room
3 Ensuite Bathrooms
Well Maintained throughout
Brand New AC Units Installed
Partial Lake View
Landscaped Private Garden
Quiet and Peaceful Location
Vacant and Ready to Move In

This highly desirable layout offers spacious interiors, enhanced privacy due to its corner positioning, and a beautifully landscaped outdoor area ideal for relaxing or entertaining. The home is designed for comfortable family living with a practical flow and bright living spaces.

Located in a well-established and secure community, residents benefit from easy access to parks, lakes, walking trails, schools, and retail amenities, making it an excellent choice for end-users seeking a serene yet well-connected lifestyle.
